subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the exact-pin guard defects are repaired, should OpenClaw accept these exact new third-party action revisions at its credential, publishing, scanning, Docker, and Codex execution boundaries?
rationale: Automated checks establish pin consistency and upstream identity, but final trust acceptance for new privileged third-party workflow code requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after full verification

options.title: Split privileged revisions
